title: Coast Guard rescues 3 people after boat capsizes 15 miles west of Bayport
description: An Mh-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew from Air Station Clearwater, Florida, rescues three boaters 17 miles west of Bayport, Wed. July 22, 2020. The boaters called the Coast Guard via VHF-FM marine band radio channel 16 after their 15-foot flat bottom fishing boat capsized. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
